implementation_scope: Bounded one-offer publisher slot; one unpaid result; ordered S consumer decodes rank from success events; drain-before-reset with staged preacceptance offer; uint64_t finite rank/sequence
source_identity_method: Compared local git hash-object (Git blob SHA-1) of every seven test/source files with exact GitHub returned blob identifiers; these bytes compiled in the container.

host_toolchain.system: Linux container, not user's local MCU

runs.command: gcc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -Iinclude src/cln_numeric.c src/cln_sync_experiment.c src/cln_flow_experiment.c tests/test_flow.c -o flow_test && ./flow_test

gcc -std=c11 -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -Iinclude src/cln_numeric.c src/cln_sync_experiment.c src/cln_flow_experiment.c tests/test_flow.c -o flow_san && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1:abort_on_error=1 ./flow_san

preliminary_failure.observed: First host test failed an energy assertion due to a test oracle summing 32 prior samples rather than 31
preliminary_failure.action: Corrected only the test oracle bound to 31 preceding samples; final optimized and sanitizer runs succeeded
preliminary_failure.claim: This is a test oracle defect, not demonstrated C kernel failure
